# The Diver's Boat Koh Phangan

> SSI dive centre in Chaloklum, Koh Phangan, Thailand, with its own boat. Daily 9:30 departures to Sail Rock, Koh Ma, Little Sail Rock and the oil platform. Small groups (maximum 20 divers on board), new 2024 equipment, teaching in six languages. Opened January 2024; part of The Diver's Boat, on Koh Tao since 2015.

## Key facts

- Location: 25, 47 Moo 7, Chaloklum, Koh Phangan, Surat Thani 84280, Thailand (north coast of Koh Phangan). Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/bEEDKP3wQrKL8BUb9
- Contact and booking: WhatsApp / phone +66 95 438 5374 · thaidivingpro@gmail.com · Instagram @thediversboatkpg
- Certification agency: SSI (Scuba Schools International)
- Boat: the Rungworawan, our own boat, maximum 20 divers
- Departure: 9:30 daily from Chaloklum, back at the pier in the afternoon
- Group sizes: Try Dive 2 students per instructor; Open Water 4 students per instructor; Fun Dive 4 divers per guide
- Languages: Spanish, English, French, Dutch, Hebrew, Russian; Chinese spoken in the shop
- Included in every price: SSI instructor or guide, full equipment (XS to XXL, new 2024), snacks and water, underwater video of your dive
- Google rating: 5.0 from 354 reviews (September 2026)

## Prices (Thai baht, per person)

- Snorkelling trip to Sail Rock: 1,500฿ (1 day)
- Fun Dive for certified divers: 3,200฿ (1 day)
- Try Dive, no certification needed: 4,200฿ (1 day)
- SSI Basic Diver: 4,900฿ (1 day)
- SSI Open Water Diver: 12,900฿ (3 days, to 18 m)
- SSI Advanced Open Water: 12,500฿ (2 days)
- SSI Specialty Diver: 12,500฿ (2 days)
- SSI Deep Diving Specialty: 8,500฿ (2 days, to 40 m)
- SSI Rescue Diver: 11,600฿ (2 days)
- SSI Enriched Air Nitrox: from 4,200฿ (1 day)

## Dive sites

- Sail Rock (Hin Bai): open-sea pinnacle, 5–40 m, with The Chimney swim-through. Barracuda, batfish, trevally, whale sharks with luck. About 1 hour by boat. All levels.
- Koh Ma: hard-coral garden 10 minutes from Chaloklum, 5–18 m, no current. Turtles, clownfish, cuttlefish. Beginners and courses.
- Little Sail Rock: small pinnacle, 8–20 m, few other divers. Giant groupers, morays, fusiliers. Intermediate.
- Oil Platform: artificial structure in open water, 10–30 m, huge schools of jacks, barracuda and groupers. Advanced, 20+ logged dives.

## Team
